title: Attention trong ngữ cảnh
text: Attention considers how relevant tokens are to one another in context. Query, key, and value participate in the calculation. Query represents the current information request. Key represents information that can be matched. Value carries the content passed into the result. Context helps a token receive meaning from surrounding tokens. Attention does not make every token equally important. The result combines information from related tokens. Related tokens receive more useful information for interpreting context. The source is a simplified conceptual explanation, not a full implementation formula.
